title: Paperclip scientists work on the Magenta craft

tellings.quote: Many of the top Nazi scientists as a part of Operation Paperclip that the Allies had exfiltrated also made their way to Wright Patterson to work on the magenta craft.

plain: Top German scientists from the Nazi era, brought to the US after the war under Operation Paperclip, the American programme that recruited them, are said to have gone to Wright-Patterson Air Force Base in Ohio to work on the "Magenta craft," a UFO said to have crashed in Italy. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, in an episode with the presidential advisor Harald Malmgren. If true, some of the best rocket and aircraft minds of the day would have been put to work studying a recovered craft.
